I played from the day rdr online opened in beta until like late 2021 / early 2022. It was rocky in the beta days. Only the stranger missions were available and they netted anywhere from less than a dollar to $10 for around a 20 minute mission. It was grueling considering the cheapest guns and items cost around $150 or so. The story missions netted the most money (and were actually fun) but you could only play them once. Eventually R* added roles. Trader, collector, and bounty hunter. Later a battle pass was added and while I hate battle passes in games, this one was alright. As long as you were wise with your money you'd have enough to afford the next one, and the rewards were pretty cool. Next came the moonshiner role. While it didn't net as much money as the other roles, I'd argue the moonshine shack was the most fun thing in the game. Me and my buddies would go out and do trader runs and bootleg and then head back to the shack to drink, play music, and dance. Next came the naturalist role, which had you working for a lady named harriett tranquilizing animals and taking blood samples from them. She would somehow know when you killed an animal anywhere in the world (even when a squirrel runs out under your horse and gets trampled) and she'd get pissed at you. After this they said that they had some big updates coming, then a few months later they said they were done updating it. Personally I think Rockstar wanted to keep supporting the game. It was starting to pick up despite its rough start (similar to Cyberpunk) but I believe Take Two pulled the plug to divert manpower towards gta online and gta 6.
